# Rule: Public virtual method's possible dispatch set changed

_Canonical rule slug:_ `public-virtual-dispatch-set-changed`. [← back to all rules](index.md)

> A stable public virtual method gains or loses an override that a virtual call through it may reach, so the same symbol can now land in different code. An over-approximated source-graph risk to review, not an ABI break.
